GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Settled Down 3 Wide Off Mid-Field 5 Lengths @ 1100m. Hooked Out Four Wide midrace. widest well back Straightening Up . all Clear , Just Held Ground well back # wide/no run on
Jumped Ok sat 8l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 5l off all clear, worked home well but never a threat # hit line well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1300m, commenced to race fiercely and continued to do so for some distance thereafter.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Over-raced & worked to hold ground midrace & improving slowly from 600m. Pushed along Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & held ground in last 200m. # Wide/held ground.
Jumped Well to lead half clear, ridden along turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed 200m and gave ground # led/faded

Jumped Ok Not Bustled but Went Forward Two Wide of 5 early and a bit keen early checked off heels , Settled Down 4th 1x1 3 Lengths out 3 Wide 600m Four Wide 500m, Joined in x 300m dueled Kept Finding # Sound will 54
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When racing in restricted room near the 1000m, commenced to race very ungenerously and, near the 900m, shifted out and was checked when awkwardly placed on heels. The gelding then continued to race ungenerously for some distance thereafter. In the home straight, laid in under pressure and proved difficult to ride and, near the 300m, made contact with a rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered two lanes short of centre of track and Made Some Ground before being crowded and held up inside the last 150m and should have finished closer. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # good/bit stiff
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m was crowded for numerous strides and lost its rightful running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3-4l off 3 Wide No Cover , swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off held up, clear 100m, hit line well late # has excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide in the early and middle stages. Near the 500m was eased when crossed by another runner which shifted in when not fully clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off, improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, found little and dropped out # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race. Slow to begin and was crowded shortly after. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast and led rails 1000m, worked to Middle Of Track for best ground soon after Straightening Up , challenged from all angles last 200m but fought them all off for gutsy win, winkers off first time # gutsy all way win

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced keenly @ rear 3 Wide (5L from lead). Stayed @ rear 3 Wide midrace & 3 Wide @ 750m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Out Six Wide @ 300m & ran on well in last 200m but just missed. # Ran on well/missed.
